ex.zh: 她寫了一本名為《我在東京的生活》的書。

ex.en: The report is entitled "Future Trends in Retail."
ex.zh: 這份報告的標題是《零售業的未來趨勢》。

ex.en: I forgot to attach a stamp to the envelope.
ex.zh: 我忘了在信封上貼郵票。

ex.en: Xiaoding's father's name is written down on the envelope.
ex.zh: 信封上寫著小丁爸爸的名字。

ex.en: Tom handed the envelope full of cash to Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆把裝滿現金的信封交給瑪麗。

ex.en: The data is encoded before it is sent.
ex.zh: 資料在傳送前會先編碼。

ex.en: Messages are encoded so that hackers can't read them.
ex.zh: 訊息經過加密編碼，駭客無法讀取。

ex.en: The video was encoded in a high-quality format.
ex.zh: 這部影片以高畫質格式編碼。

ex.en: The project was enormously successful.
ex.zh: 這個專案極為成功。

ex.en: Prices vary enormously from store to store.
ex.zh: 各家店的價格差異非常大。

ex.en: I enjoyed the trip enormously.
ex.zh: 我非常享受這趟旅行。

ex.en: Enzymes help the body digest food.
ex.zh: 酵素幫助身體消化食物。

ex.en: This laundry detergent contains enzymes that remove stains.
ex.zh: 這款洗衣精含有能去除汙漬的酵素。

endeavor.zh: 努力；（需要努力的）事業、嘗試

ex.en: Self-confidence is the principal element of any great endeavor.
ex.zh: 自信是任何偉大事業的首要條件。

ex.en: We wish you the best of luck in your endeavors.
ex.zh: 祝你所有的努力都順利成功。

ex.en: He endeavored to make his wife happy, but in vain.
ex.zh: 他努力想讓妻子開心，卻徒勞無功。

ex.en: We endeavor to answer all customer inquiries within 24 hours.
ex.zh: 我們盡力在二十四小時內回覆所有客戶詢問。

ex.en: We stopped for lunch en route to the airport.
ex.zh: 我們在前往機場的途中停下來吃午餐。

ex.en: The package is en route and should arrive tomorrow.
ex.zh: 包裹正在運送途中，明天應該會到。

ex.en: My son is engaged to his secretary.
ex.zh: 我的兒子和他的秘書訂婚了。

ex.en: She is engaged to a rich man.
ex.zh: 她和一個有錢人訂了婚。

ex.en: He got engaged to my cousin.
ex.zh: 他和我的堂姊妹訂婚了。

ex.en: My father has been engaged in foreign trade for many years.
ex.zh: 我父親從事外貿多年。

ex.en: They are engaged in cancer research.
ex.zh: 他們從事癌症研究工作。

ex.en: All entrees come with a salad.
ex.zh: 所有主菜都附沙拉。

ex.en: I'll have the fish as my entree.
ex.zh: 我主菜要點魚。

ex.en: Enthusiasts of Japanese culture may enjoy the article "Ergativity and Bare Nouns in Early Old Japanese."
ex.zh: 日本文化愛好者可能會喜歡〈早期古日語的作格性與光桿名詞〉這篇文章。

ex.en: He's a car enthusiast who spends every weekend in his garage.
ex.zh: 他是汽車迷，每個週末都待在車庫裡。

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread enticed us into the bakery.
ex.zh: 剛出爐麵包的香味把我們引進了麵包店。

ex.en: The store enticed customers with big discounts.
ex.zh: 那家店用大幅折扣來吸引顧客。

ex.en: Your success excites my envy.
ex.zh: 你的成功使我感到嫉妒。

ex.en: She looked at his new house with envy.
ex.zh: 她以羨慕的眼神看著他的新房子。

ex.en: They all envied my new car.
ex.zh: 他們都羨慕我的新車。

ex.en: I have to say I envy you guys.
ex.zh: 我不得不說我羨慕你們。

ex.en: I envy you your luck.
ex.zh: 我嫉妒你的幸運。

encouraging.zh: 有激勵作用的、令人鼓舞的

ex.en: We have some encouraging news.
ex.zh: 我們有一些令人鼓舞的訊息。

ex.en: Those are encouraging signs.
ex.zh: 那些都是好跡象。

ex.en: The teacher gave him some encouraging words.
ex.zh: 老師對他說了一些鼓勵的話。

ex.en: The forest in the fall is splendidly colorful, a thoroughly enchanting sight.
ex.zh: 秋天的森林五彩斑斕，景色十分迷人。

ex.en: The beauty of the island enchanted every visitor.
ex.zh: 小島的美景讓每位遊客都為之著迷。

ex.en: The storyteller enchanted the children with tales of dragons.
ex.zh: 說書人用龍的故事迷住了孩子們。

ex.en: John is envious of your new car.
ex.zh: 約翰很忌妒你有新車。

ex.en: She was envious of her cousin's success.
ex.zh: 她羨慕她表哥的成功。

ex.en: She is envious of my good fortune.
ex.zh: 她嫉妒我的好運。

ex.en: The athlete earns millions from endorsements.
ex.zh: 那位運動員靠代言賺了數百萬。

ex.en: Celebrity endorsements can boost sales.
ex.zh: 名人代言可以提升銷量。

ex.en: A translation is not an endorsement.
ex.zh: 翻譯不代表認同。

ex.en: The plan received the endorsement of the board.
ex.zh: 這個計畫獲得董事會的支持。

ex.en: They entertained us at dinner last night.
ex.zh: 他們昨晚請我們吃晚餐。

ex.en: We often entertain clients at this restaurant.
ex.zh: 我們常在這家餐廳招待客戶。

ex.en: He entertained us with jokes all evening.
ex.zh: 他整晚講笑話逗我們開心。

ex.en: The clown entertained the children.
ex.zh: 小丑逗得孩子們很開心。

ex.en: Please see the enclosure for the full price list.
ex.zh: 完整價目表請參閱隨函附件。

ex.en: The enclosure was missing from the mailed package.
ex.zh: 寄出的郵件裡漏了附件。

ex.en: The company is hiring for an entry-level position.
ex.zh: 公司正在招募初階職位人員。

ex.en: This entry-level role includes on-the-job training.
ex.zh: 這個初階職位提供在職訓練。

ex.en: The handbook lists each worker’s annual leave entitlement.
ex.zh: 員工手冊列出每位員工應享有的年假天數。

ex.en: Before approving the claim, HR checked her entitlement to relocation support.
ex.zh: 核准申請前，人資確認了她是否符合搬遷補助資格。

ex.en: Encryption protects customer data during transfer.
ex.zh: 加密可在傳輸過程中保護客戶資料。

ex.en: The app uses encryption to secure each message.
ex.zh: 這款 App 使用加密技術保護每則訊息。

ex.en: Please wait for me at the entrance of the building.
ex.zh: 請在建築的入口處等我。

ex.en: Some people were hanging around at the entrance.
ex.zh: 有些人在入口處停留。

ex.en: Because the entrance was locked, we couldn't enter the house.
ex.zh: 因為門口鎖住了，我們進不了屋子。

ex.en: I hear you passed the entrance exam. Congratulations!
ex.zh: 我聽說你通過了入學考試。恭喜你了！

ex.en: He is busy preparing for the entrance examination.
ex.zh: 他忙著準備入學考試。

ex.en: Entry is strictly for staff only.
ex.zh: 僅限工作人員進入。

ex.en: Disregarding the "No Entry" sign, she pushed open the door and walked inside.
ex.zh: 她不理會「禁止進入」的牌子，推開門走了進去。

ex.en: This dictionary has about 40,000 entries.
ex.zh: 這本字典大約有四萬個詞條。

ex.en: I made an entry in my diary every night.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上都會寫一篇日記。

ex.en: She sent me the enclosed check.
ex.zh: 她把隨信附上的支票寄給了我。

ex.en: Please find the enclosed contract.
ex.zh: 隨函附上合約，請查收。
